body.raw:
I am extremely frustrated with the way this order has been handled. My food order was supposed to arrive much earlier, but it has now been delayed by almost an hour, and I have already spent a significant amount of time waiting for it.

This is not just a minor delay. When I place a food order, I do so expecting it to arrive within the estimated delivery time that was shown to me. I planned my meal around that timing, and because of this delay, I have been left waiting with no proper update or resolution.

What is even more frustrating is that I have had to repeatedly check the status of the order instead of receiving a clear explanation from your side. If there was going to be such a significant delay, I should have been informed properly much earlier.

At this point, I want two things: **I want my food order to be delivered, and I also want a double refund/compensation for the inconvenience and excessive delay.** I do not want the order to be cancelled after making me wait for nearly an hour, and I also do not think a simple apology or a small coupon adequately addresses this situation.

I have already waited this long, so please make sure the order is delivered as soon as possible. At the same time, please process the appropriate refund/compensation for the delay. I am requesting a **double refund along with the order**, considering the amount of time wasted and the inconvenience caused.

Please do not give me a generic response asking me to wait another 20–30 minutes. I have already waited far beyond the promised delivery time. I expect this to be escalated and resolved properly rather than being given another estimated time that may not be followed.

I have been patient throughout this entire situation, but my patience is now exhausted. Please deliver the order and provide the double refund/compensation that I am requesting for this unacceptable delay.
